title: Changing Min and Max through the parts import writes an Import entry
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MMIMPORT-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with Min 2 and Max 6.
  • Parts import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MMIMPORT.csv) has one row for {Part-A} with the same values except Min 4 and Max 9.
custom_steps:
1. Upload {File-A} on Settings → Data Import → Inventory and run the import.
  2. Open {Part-A}'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The import finishes without errors.
  • Step 2: An entry reads "Min/Max updated | Min: 2 → 4 | Max: 6 → 9 | Source: Import".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R22a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows the import. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R22a: “Changing Min or Max writes "Min/Max updated | Min: {old} → {new} | Max: {old} → {new} | Source: {source}" to the part's Part History, where the source is "Edit Part" or "Import". No entry is written when neither value changed.”
